Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing ONE issue in the Email OS Vue/Tauri client (repo = your worktree). Read first: PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md ("Contact Pane" section), src/components/ContactPane.vue (`recent` prop, "Recent cached mail"), and where App.vue computes and passes `recent` (grep `recent` / `ContactPane` in src/App.vue and src/composables/useMailbox.ts), plus tests referencing recent mail (grep tests/ and src for 'Recent cached mail', 'recent').

## Shared rules (all reader-review tasks)
- Context: we compared our conversation reader against a Superhuman screenshot; in our contact pane, "Recent cached mail from sender" lists the conversation that is currently OPEN ("Fixture thread 1" is listed while thread 1 is open), so the first entry is a link to where you already are. (A previous critique flagged the same for the focused conversation.)
- Stay on-brand per PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md: terse, honest-state. Don't fabricate data. Keep the pane layout (24px pitch rows pinned to list geometry) intact.
- Keep every existing `data-test` attribute and aria-label; update tests in tests/ and src that your change legitimately affects (explain each in the report). Do NOT edit DESIGN.md or PRODUCT.md — put design-doc notes in your final report.
- Other agents are changing nearby files in parallel on separate branches (reader toolbar/header, snippets, etc.); you should touch only ContactPane.vue / the App.vue computation of `recent` / tests. Keep your diff MINIMAL; no reformatting.
- Setup: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. Verify with `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` (full suite; report honestly incl. pre-existing failures).
- Preview: `pnpm dev --port <PORT> --strictPort` (in-memory fixture workspace). Use mcp__t3-code__preview_* tools (load via ToolSearch), resize 1280x800, press Enter on the focused first row to open "Fixture thread 1: weekly status". Stop dev server and close preview tab when done.
- Evidence: save PNGs under the evidence dir below (mkdir -p). BEFORE (base commit) and AFTER at 1280x800 via preview_snapshot save=true (copy screenshotPath to named files). If blurry, retry and include the DOM text of the pane in your report.
- Commit on your worktree's branch (no push, no PR). End the commit message with: `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Final report (brief): branch + head SHA, files changed, what you did, tests run/results, evidence absolute paths, DESIGN.md notes, anything you couldn't do.

## Your issue: P3 – Recent cached mail repeats the open thread
- Exclude the currently open (context 'open') or focused (context 'focused') conversation from the `recent` list, matching by ConversationRef identity (account + conversation id), not by subject text. The list size cap must be applied AFTER excluding so the pane still shows up to the same number of other conversations when available.
- When the sender has no other cached conversations: hide the "Recent cached mail" section entirely (no empty heading) OR, if the existing design/tests require an explicit empty state, show a one-line honest empty note ("No other cached mail from this sender") — check what the code/tests do today for the empty case and keep that behaviour consistent; report your choice.
- Keep J/K/open-recent behaviour (`openRecent` emit) intact.
- Evidence dir: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p3-recent-mail . PORT: 5207. Required: before/after at 1280x800 with a thread open, after with the list focused (not open) showing the focused conversation excluded, and an after screenshot of the empty/other-senders case if reachable in the fixtures (else tweak a scratch fixture, screenshot, revert).

content.text:
"Recent cached mail" no longer lists the conversation you're in. In the contact pane, the open or focused thread is now left out, and the section hides when the sender has no other cached mail. Typecheck is clean and the full suite passes (702 passed, 32 skipped).

- **Branch and commit:** `exclude-current-recent-thread` at `737e759`. Nothing is pushed and there's no PR.
- **Files changed:** `src/App.vue`, `tests/app.search-intent.test.ts`, `tests/contact-pane.component.test.ts`. `ContactPane.vue` and the docs are untouched.
- **The change:** in `src/App.vue`, `recentMail` is now computed from the fetched list. It drops the open conversation when the reader is open, otherwise the focused one, matching on account plus conversation id. It then keeps the first four. Before this change the search result was cut to four first, so removing the current thread would have left only three.
- **Empty case:** I hid the section. `ContactPane.vue` already renders it only when the list is non-empty, and no test expected an empty-state note, so I added none.
- **Unchanged:** `openRecent` and J/K behave as before, and all `data-test` and aria attributes are kept.

**Tests**
- The existing "recent link" case in the archive-receipt test assumed the first recent link opens `rows[0]`, which was the thread already open. It now expects `rows[1]` (the same destination as `j`). I also renamed the "reopening the same reader" test, since it now opens a different thread.
- New App test: neither the open nor the focused subject appears among the recent links, and thread 2 does.
- New ContactPane test: `recent: []` renders no `.contact-recent` section.
- The new App test and the updated recent-link case both fail on the old `App.vue`.
- Under parallel load, 3–6 unrelated tests (palette, saved-split, reminders, cached-trash) timed out on a few full runs, and the set differed each time. They passed when rerun alone and in the final full run. The baseline before my change was also green.

**Screenshots at 1280×800** in `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sofianebebert-workspace-worktrees-email-os-t3-8289bc5f/c76d33d1-bfb7-485b-a7f9-1da77be42a31/scratchpad/evidence/p3-recent-mail/`:
- `before-open-1280x800.png`: thread 1 is open and "Fixture thread 1" is listed first, followed by threads 2–4.
- `after-open-1280x800.png`: thread 1 is open and the pane lists threads 2–5.
- `after-focused-1280x800.png`: the list is focused with nothing open, and the pane shows threads 2–5.
- `after-no-other-mail-scratch-fixture-1280x800.png`: the pane has no "Recent cached mail" section. The default fixtures give the hostile sender three threads, so I temporarily gave them one and reverted it. The reverted file is not in the commit.

**DESIGN.md note** (not edited): in the Contact Pane section, add that "Recent cached mail" excludes the open or focused conversation by account plus conversation id, shows up to four other conversations, and is hidden when there are none, with no empty-state copy.

The dev server and preview tab are closed.
